name: Maple Avenue Barber Shop

services.name: Haircut
services.note: Scissor or clipper cut, finished with a hot towel.

services.name: Hot shave
services.note: Straight razor and hot towels, finished with a cold one.

services.name: Kids' cut
services.note: For children four and up — usually a fifteen-minute job.

about_paragraphs: Two chairs, a wall of mirrors and a stack of magazines that is always a few months old.

The shop has been on Ladybug Lane since 2016, in a narrow storefront between a laundromat and a corner store. Most of the people in the chairs are regulars from Durand and Kirkendall, and a few of them have been coming since the first month.
The week runs one way: quiet mornings Tuesday to Thursday, a full house on Friday afternoons and Saturday morning. Kids are welcome, and there is a booster seat by the second chair.
pricing_note: Haircuts, beard trims and hot shaves are priced at the counter. Cash and card both work, and there is no card minimum.
new_client_note: First time in the chair? Say so at the counter and the barber will take a minute to work out what you want before starting.
cancellation_note: If the time you asked for no longer works, one phone call is enough — there is no charge for changing it.
licence_note: A personal service setting inspected by Hamilton Public Health.
